name: topoloop
description: Animated, looping graph walkthroughs for slides, driven by a TypeScript spec. Vue component, Slidev, and mp4/gif export.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run render
scripts.export:gif: node scripts/export.mjs --spec checkout-demo --theme dark --seed 1 --format gif --fps 15 --from 0 --to 10 --width 800 --out docs/demo.gif && node scripts/export.mjs --spec checkout-demo --theme light --seed 1 --format gif --fps 15 --from 0 --to 10 --width 800 --out docs/demo-light.gif
